svg.title: FieldFox: bring the bits, keep the final say
svg.desc: An illustrated overview explains source to form in six stages. Supplied source and form context are processed by a configured server and model provider. The server validates a plan, the widget writes supported fields and reads them back, and the human reviews the facts. FieldFox never submits the form.
svg.text: ILLUSTRATIVE MACHINE · REAL SOFTWARE FLOW BELOW
SIMPLE ON THE SURFACE. INSPECTABLE UNDERNEATH.
A successful write is not proof of a correct fact. Compare the result with your source.
Source + included form context leave the browser for the configured server and model provider.
CONCEPT STUDY · CLOUD PRE-LAUNCH · SAME MIT WIDGET FOR HOSTED AND SELF-HOSTED DELIVERY
